# NEWS ADATA Unveils LEGEND Series PCIe M.2 2280 Solid State Drives (United States)

# ADATA Unveils LEGEND Series PCIe M.2 2280 Solid State Drives

11.02.2021

Performance that enables a higher level of content creation for different needs and budgets

Taipei, Taiwan – Nov. 2, 20 21 – ADATA Technology (Taiwan Stock Exchange: 3260.TWO), a manufacturer of high-performance DRAM modules, NAND Flash products, mobile accessories, gaming products, electric power trains, and industrial solutions today announces a new series of solid state drives (SSD), the ADATA LEGEND series, geared toward creators of different needs and budgets. They include the ADATA LEGEND 740, 750, and 840. 

Accelerating Creativity 

The LEGEND 740 and 750 utilize PCIe Gen3 x4 and NVMe 1.3 to deliver sequential read and write speeds of up to 2,500/2,000 and 3,500/3,000 MB per second, respectively, to give creators the performance they need to create without limitations. Their M.2 2280 specifications support the latest Intel® and AMD platforms for creating on the latest PCs, including desktop and laptops. For users seeking a further boost, the LEGEND 840 takes advantage of PCIe Gen4 x4 and NVMe 1.4 to offer read and write speeds of up to 5,000/4,500 MB per second.

Seamless Productivity

The LEGEND 740, 750, and 840 are equipped with SLC Caching and Host Memory Buffer technology for seamless productivity. This gives them 4K random read write speeds of up to 180K/200K, 480K/260K and 440K/400K IOPS, respectively. In way of capacity, the LEGEND series come with up to 1TB of capacity. 

Protected, Accurate, and Reliable 

All three SSDs are equipped with understated but elegant heat sinks with sleek side trimmings. The heat sinks not only look great, but also help keep temperatures down by 15% for optimal performance and stability. With Low Density Parity Check Code and AES 256-bit encryption, the SSDs ensure accurate data transmissions and offer robust security. LEGEND series SSDs use only high quality ICs that have been rigorously tested for maximum durability. For further peace of mind, they come backed by a 5-year warranty. 

Play Hard Too

The LEGEND 840 can also be installed on a PS5 as a secondary drive, giving users more storage space and smoother game loading*. To find out about availability and prices in specific markets, please contact your nearest ADATA representative via www.adata.com. 

* This product has been tested and confirmed to be compatible with PS5. Actual speed may vary depending on hardware and software configurations. For more about compatibility, please click here.

...

ADATA Technology is the world's second-largest vendor of DRAM memory and branded solid state drives, ranks among the top 25 international brands from Taiwan, and holds over 500 memory-related patents. ADATA's main product lines include memory modules, USB flash drives, memory cards, solid state drives, and portable hard drives. By adhering to a spirit of continuous innovation and extraordinary excellence, ADATA products have garnered international acclaim and awards including iF Design, Red Dot Design, CES Innovation, Good Design, COMPUTEX Best Choice, and Taiwan Excellence. ADATA has also been honored for its commitment to employee welfare and corporate social responsibility, including being certified as a Great Place to Work ® and recognized with an Asia Responsible Enterprise Award and Best Companies to Work for in Asia Award for two consecutive years. The hummingbird is ADATA's brand mascot. It represents the company's agility and efficiency as well as its pursuit of innovation and commitment to creating a more color and intelligent life for people. For more information, please visit www.adata.com.

Highlights:
# ADATA Legend 840 2TB PCIe Gen4 x4 NVMe 1.4 M.2 Internal Gaming SSD Up to 5,000 MB/s (ALEG-840-2TCS)
Brand: ADATA
Category: Data Storage > Internal Solid State Drives

## Features
PCIe Gen4 x4 interface. NVMe 1.4 support; Excellent read/write performance 5,000/4,500 MB per second. Note Backward compatible with PCIe 3.0. If a third-generation PCIe motherboard is used, this product will be able to achieve sequential read/write speeds of 3400/3000MB per second; Heat sink keeps SSD 15% cooler for optimal performance and stability; With LDPC (Low Density Parity Check Code) and AES 256-bit encryption, the LEGEND 840 ensures accurate data transmissions and security; LEGEND series SSDs use only high quality ICs that have been rigorously tested. For further peace of mind, they come backed by a 5-year warranty

## Specifications
Color: LEGEND 840; Hard-Drive Size: 2 TB; Additional Features: Portable; Digital Storage Capacity: 2000 GB; Hard Disk Interface: NVMe

## Pricing & Reviews
Rated 4.4 from 447 reviews.
Top review: Purchased strictly to upgrade internal storage for the PS5. Must be a Gen4 NVMe type SSD. Yes there are many other SSD's with slightly higher read/write speeds etc. that cost way more... But why spend more... the PS5 is limited to a specific speed which this ADATA 840 Legend meets.The installation on the PS5 is a Breeze... the hardest part was removing the Top Panel of the Console for the first time.So if you are on the Fence about this SSD working in the PS5....?? Trust me it does... and the performance is Fast just as Fast as the interal SSD built into the PS5

## Details
Model: ALEG-840-2TCS

ASIN: B09H8687FN
